body: sixteen hours. that's all the warning folklore got before it dropped in 2020 — no single, no rollout, no lead time. she still became the first artist ever to debut at #1 on both the Hot 100 ("cardigan") and the Billboard 200, same week, in either chart's 60+ year history.
